title: Maximum of Absolute Value Expression
description: Find the maximum value of |arr1[i] - arr1[j]| + |arr2[i] - arr2[j]| + |i - j|.
pseudocode:
1. maxVal = -Infinity
2. For s1 in [-1, 1], s2 in [-1, 1]:
3.   minV = Infinity, maxV = -Infinity
4.   For i = 0 to n-1:
5.     val = arr1[i] + s1*arr2[i] + s2*i
6.     minV = min(minV, val)
7.     maxV = max(maxV, val)
8.   maxVal = max(maxVal, maxV - minV)

steps.note: Initialize maxVal to track the global maximum result.
Pick combination s1=1, s2=1 for the expression expansion.
Iterate through the array to find min and max values for the current sign combination.
Update maxVal with the difference between current max (6) and min (3).
